citationPolicy.japaneseStrings: Every Japanese string in this record is a word under test, a JMdict headword (entry number given in 'citedExpressions'), a dictionary name, a headword used only to identify a WARODAI article or Kotobank entry, or a work title.

entries.neighbouringSenses: 1 sky/the air/the heavens; 2 weather; 4 state of mind; 5 (from) memory; 6 falsehood; 7–8 noun prefixes
entries.proves: JMdict lists a noun sense 'far-off place; distant place' for そら, separate from 'sky'.
entries.doesNotProve: It gives no Russian rendering and no adverbial or adjectival use; it does not equate そら with «далеко», «вдали» or «далёкий».

entries.proves: The whole expression 旅の空 is a recorded dictionary entry with this meaning.
entries.doesNotProve: An expression-level gloss does not establish a standalone equivalence for its constituent 空.

jmdict.independence: First direct check of the EDRDG release for this question; the earlier Kolobok lead (149 record) was only JMdict-derived.

verifiedPhraseCases.description: The article has one example built on the expression 旅の空 with a locative particle. Its Russian rendering is a locative phrase that keeps a word for 'sky' with a 'foreign' modifier.
verifiedPhraseCases.doesNotProve: No bare 空 rendered as «далеко», «вдали» or «далёкий».

verifiedPhraseCases.source: WARODAI, article いきょう【異境・異郷】 009-24-70
verifiedPhraseCases.description: The article's headword gloss carries the foreign-land meaning. Its one example that contains 空 is marked poetic and is rendered as a phrase of longing in a foreign land; no separate Russian word is attributed to 空. The article's other example, which has no 空, gets a rendering of the same kind. Inference from this structure: the foreign-land meaning comes from 異境, not from 空.
verifiedPhraseCases.doesNotProve: No rendering of bare 空 as a foreign-land word or as a distance word.

verifiedPhraseCases.source: デジタル大辞泉 via Kotobank, headword 旅の空, sense 2
verifiedPhraseCases.description: Sense 2 of this expression entry covers the same idea as the JMdict gloss: being away from home while travelling.

verifiedPhraseCases.source: 精選版 日本国語大辞典 via Kotobank, headword そら【空】, sense [一]④
verifiedPhraseCases.description: A remote-from-one's-base sense that stresses circumstance and mood (insecurity or sadness); it is illustrated with a classical passage from 竹取物語 that uses the 旅の空 expression.
verifiedPhraseCases.doesNotProve: No Russian rendering; emphasises circumstance and mood, not a measured distance.

verifiedPhraseCases.source: デジタル大辞泉 via Kotobank, headword そら【空】, sense 3 and its listed examples
verifiedPhraseCases.description: Sense 3 is the dictionary's remote-place sense, matching JMdict 1245290 sense 3. The entry lists three short examples: one is the expression 旅の空 and the other two are further N+の空-shaped phrases, which are not reproduced here (see the cited entry). Exact-string WARODAI lookups of those two phrases returned no entries on 2026-11-11.
verifiedPhraseCases.doesNotProve: No Russian rendering is attested for either unreproduced example.

controlCases.description: The only checked 空-containing WARODAI example whose Russian rendering contains a distance adverb: the example combines 虚空 with the adverb はるか, the distance adverb renders はるか, and 虚空 is rendered through its sky sense (the article marks 虚空 as book-style).

controlCases.source: WARODAI, articles そら【空I】 002-00-71 and たび【旅】 001-51-23
controlCases.description: In both articles the reversed-order compound is rendered as air travel (sky sense).

gloss: a man's heart is as fickle as autumn weather

controlCases.source: WARODAI, articles あき【秋】 001-19-42 and おとこごころ【男心】 003-00-60
controlCases.description: In the inspected examples of these two expressions, 空 is rendered as sky or weather. These examples do not establish a rule for non-place nouns; the N+の空 pattern alone does not determine the sense.

controlCases.source: WARODAI, article あからむ【赤らむ】 006-02-83
controlCases.description: The article's example has a compass-direction noun modifying 空 as the subject of 赤らむ; 空 still means sky there.

russianToJapaneseHeadwords.source: プログレッシブ ロシア語辞典（露和編）, Shogakukan, via Kotobank
russianToJapaneseHeadwords.observation: None of the checked headword entries lists 空/そら among its Japanese equivalents; the 和露 entry そら gives only sky/heavens.
russianToJapaneseHeadwords.limitation: Mid-size dictionary; omission is not proof that a context-dependent rendering is impossible.

unsupportedClaims: Bare 空/そら glossed as «далеко», «вдали», «вдалеке» or «далёкий»: not found in any checked source.

Bare 空/そら glossed with the search terms «чужбина» or «далёкие края»: not found in any checked source. In WARODAI 009-24-70 the foreign-land meaning is carried by the headword gloss and by phrase-level renderings of the article's two examples, never by a rendering of 空 alone (V2).
Naminori/Kolobok Russian wording: unchanged lead status from the 149 record; not re-verified.
corrections: The remote-place examples inspected in the cited entries are N+の空-shaped phrases (one is the JMdict expression 旅の空; the others are described in V2 and V5-V6 without being reproduced). The checked entries do not establish an exhaustive syntactic restriction; do not infer that other constructions are impossible or use that inference alone to declare either pair safe.

No checked source labels the whole remote-place sense as literary or phrase-bound. WARODAI marks only one specific example in 009-24-70 as poetic, and the 竹取物語 citation in V4 is one historical example; keep such qualifications tied to those examples, not to the sense.
